package.name: bot_odometry
package.description: Wheel odometry + ultrasonic node: converts Teensy-reported quadrature encoder ticks into nav_msgs/Odometry for robot_localization's EKF, and Teensy-reported ultrasonic echo pulses into sensor_msgs/Range. Real hardware only -- Gazebo sim gets equivalent odometry for free from bot_gazebo's DiffDrive plugin (see CLAUDE.md).
